tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ dpal mgon ma ning nag po las: gtor ma la brten pa'i dregs pa'i srog dbang bsdus pa bzhugs so:

che mchog he ru ka dpal dang: dpal mgon ma ning nag po la: dang po nyid du phyag 'tshal lo: dregs pa'i gtor dbang bsdus pa ni: las la sbyor dngos rjes gsum ste: sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i las rim ni: che mchog phyag rdor la sogs pa'i: yi dam bsnyen pa thems pa dang: khyad par ma ning bsnyen sgrub rnams: gzhung ltar thems pa'i slob dpon gyis: dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad sgo rdzogs bya: dkyil 'khor dbus su khri yi steng: dpal mgon sku bcas gsham par bya: gta' gtor rgyun gtor mchod gtor bshams: yi dam mgon po'i las gzhung bsrang: ma ning sngags kyis khug par bkug: tshogs dang bskang gso rgyas par bya: de dag sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'o: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la: maṇ+ḍal phul dang zhu gsol dang: gnyen pos slob bu byin brlabs dang: gtor dbang dngos su bskur ba dang: zhal gdams lung gis dbang byin no: slob bus khrus byas phyag 'tshal te: dngos po gser dang sman sogs kyi: maṇ+ḍal rim gsum phul byas nas: 'di ltar gsol ba btab pa ni: rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor bas: dregs pa kun la dbang bsgyur ba: sgrub chen rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs: bdag cag byang chub sems bskyed cing: 'phags mchod 'gro don bgyid dgongs pas: bdud dang 'byung po log 'dren dang: mi nag srin po gdong dmar gyis: byang chub bar chad bstan pa bshig: de yi gnyen por dregs pa'i dbang: chos skyong srog dbang mthu rtsal zhu: zhes zhus bla mas 'di skad gsungs: ho: zhi khro bde gshegs lha bsnyen cing: rnal 'byor dam tshig la gnas na: chos skyong rnams kyis bran khol byed: dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa na: ma bsgrub par yang chos skyong nyan: 'on kyang zhu ba de bzhin du: dregs pa'i gtso mchog ma ning che: bsrung mar gtad kyis dam tshig srungs: gnyen po'i dbang ni slob bu nyid: phyag rdor du yang gsal ba la: bla ma che mchog du gsal bas snying khar hūm̐ bri:

lag du rdo rje dril bu gtad la: hūm̐: gtum chen bzang po deng nas ni: khyod kyang phyag rdor sku ru gyur: dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yi: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang: phrin las lnga ru dbang yang bskur: khyod kyang phyag rdor skur gyur nas: dregs pa kun gyi gnyen po ste: thams cad dbang sdud tshar gcod shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: ho: bu khyod phyag rdor dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su gyur nas: dregs pa dbang du sdud zil gyis mnan nas bran du khol nus pa'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par gyur cig: gnyis pa ni: dbang dngos bskur ba la: gser la sogs dngos po rnam dag gi maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul byas la: rdo rje slob dpon che mchog tu gsal bas: gtor ma sku bcas dpal mgon bskyed: slob bu yang mgon por bskyed par bya: ru mtshon bing g.yas snying zhags g.yon: sgrub yig snying kha bla rdo mchan du gtad: dpal gtor bu yi spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: 'og min gnas mchog dam pa nas: yongs rdzogs dpal gyis byin phob la: mos pa'i bu la dbang skur cig: steng phyogs dga' ldan lha yul nas: lha chen dpal 'bar byin phob la: mos pa'i bu la dbang skur cig: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: ma ning nag pos byin= mos pa'i bu la dbang= u tsa la yi dur khrod nas: srog bdud nag pos byin= mos pa'i bu la dbang= me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong dkyil nas: yum mchog dpal 'bar byin= mos pa'i bu la dbang= bdud rgyal thod phreng byin phob la: gnam lcags spu gris= tshogs kyi bdag pos= bha ga nag pos= bya rgod thang nag= tā ki nag pos= 'dzam lha nag pos= gza' bdud nag pos= gtsug lag khang skyong= khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i byin phob la: srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i byin= phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i byin phob la: mos pa'i bu la dbang skur cig: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa:

ma hā kro tī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gha na gu h+ya raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: ces sogs tshang bar brjod la bskur: ༈ srog dbang gtor ma la brten nas bsdus par bskur ba ni: gta' gtor: rgyun gtor: mchod tshogs bsham la las gzhung bsrang: ma ning sngags kyis khug par bkug: mchod bstod tshar rjes su: bdag nyid che mchog tu gsal bas: dpal gtor sku dang bcas pa dpal mgon sku dngos su bskyed la: slob ma yang ma ning du bskyed la: bing dang ru mtshon g.yas: snying dang zhags pa g.yon: sgrub yig snying kha: bla rdo mchan du gtad: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la: gong gi byin 'beb bya zhing rol mo bsgrags: che mchog dang ma ning gi rtsa sngags sham bur: kā ya ā bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka ā bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsit+ta ā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba ā bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: zhes gnas bzhir gtug cing slob bu la yang yang bstim: rtsa sngags mang du bzlas so: des kyang dbang bzhi dam par thob nas: phrin las 'grub par 'gyur ro: ma ning gi gsang sgrub dbang las tshogs bcas pa dge ri'i brag la: : sa ma ya: gter rgya: gtad rgya: kha tham: rgya rgya rgya: dge ri brag nas rat+na gling pas bton// su la ma bstan snying gi dkyil du chongs// snying gi bu mchog gcig dang 'phrad par shog /rgya rgya rgya/ shu bhaṃ/// /
